review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: As a Network Engineer with Python, you must meet most of the following criteria: Advanced knowledge of computer networking, including switching and routing at Cisco CCNA level, extended by hands-on expertise in advanced routing protocols (BGP, iBGP, eBGP), ECMP, link aggregation technologies, and tunnelling solutions such as VXLAN, GRE, and VPNs Experience in configuring network hardware (routers, switches, NICs, etc.) Have Python programming skills & experience with Python test frameworks (e.g. PyTest, PyATS) Experience in working with Linux and Git Have Experience with CI/CD tools and processes Very good command of English (B2 level at minimum, but preferably C1 or C2) Beyond the criteria above, we would appreciate the nice-to-haves: Cisco CCNP certification or equivalent knowledge Experience with SD-WAN Practical use of AI-powered tools (e.g., LLMs, code assistants) to accelerate test
